title: Legacy Cascaded DAE
subtitle: Thesis model

nodes.title: Triggered multichannel epoch
description: Resample to checkpoint-native dimensions; preserve channel order.
Normalise with recorded global mean/std; flatten channels and time.

nodes.title: Legacy DAE 1
description: Dense encoder and decoder with LeakyReLU / Dropout.

nodes.title: Legacy DAE 2
description: Also consumes the original normalised input.

nodes.title: Sum both outputs
description: The historical adapter adds both DAE predictions.
It does not feed a residual into DAE 2.

nodes.title: Restore artifact units
description: Reshape, undo target normalisation, resample to epoch boundaries.
Return multichannel artifact data to DeepLearningCorrection.
